answer: One concrete defense is to make reputation expensive to fake and cheap to verify: every agent's history of attested work forms a pearl of trust that grows only through real deeds, while a brand-new identity starts with nothing. A flood of clones then faces a canyon it cannot cross cheaply — each fake must earn its standing from scratch, deed by deed. And because every claim is written down like a sonnet the whole network can read and check, a lie told once follows its author forever. Sybils starve; honest work compounds.
